1.english_reference: And David assembled all the princes of Israel , the princes of the tribes ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּקְהֵ֣ל דָּוִ֣יד אֶת כָּל שָׂרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל שָׂרֵ֣י הַ שְּׁבָטִ֣ים
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐξεκκλησίασεν Δαυεὶδ πάντας τοὺς ἄρχοντας Ἰσραὴλ ἄρχοντας τῶν κριτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Convocávit ígitur David omnes príncipes Israel , duces tríbuum ,
traditions.KJV: And David assembled all the princes of Israel , the princes of the tribes ,

1.english_reference: and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course ,

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׂרֵ֣י הַ מַּחְלְק֣וֹת הַ מְשָׁרְתִ֪ים אֶת הַ מֶּ֟לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας τῶν ἐφημεριῶν τῶν περὶ τὸ σῶμα τοῦ βασιλέως ,
traditions.VUL: et præpósitos turmárum , qui ministrábant regi :
traditions.KJV: and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course ,

1.english_reference: and the captains over the thousands , and captains over the hundreds ,

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׂרֵ֣י הָ אֲלָפִ֣ים וְ שָׂרֵ֣י הַ מֵּא֡וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἄρχοντας τῶν χιλιάδων καὶ τῶν ἑκατοντάδων ,
traditions.VUL: tribúnos quoque et centuriónes ,
traditions.KJV: and the captains over the thousands , and captains over the hundreds ,

1.english_reference: and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king , and of his sons ,

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׂרֵ֣י כָל רְכוּשׁ וּ מִקְנֶה֩ לַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ וּ לְ בָנָ֜י
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς γαζοφύλακας , καὶ τοὺς ἐπὶ τῶν ὑπαρχόντων αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: et qui prǽerant substántiæ et possessiónibus regis , filiósque suos
traditions.KJV: and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king , and of his sons ,

1.english_reference: with the officers , and with the mighty men , and with all the valiant men , unto Jerusalem .

traditions.WLC: ו עִם הַ סָּרִיסִ֧ים וְ הַ גִּבּוֹרִ֛ים וּֽ לְ כָל גִּבּ֥וֹר חָ֖יִל אֶל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς δυνάστας , καὶ τοὺς μαχητὰς ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.VUL: cum eunúchis , et poténtes et robustíssimos quosque in exércitu Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: with the officers , and with the mighty men , and with all the valiant men , unto Jerusalem .

2.english_reference: Then David the king stood up upon his feet , and said ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֨קָם דָּוִ֤יד הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ עַל רַגְלָ֔י ו וַ יֹּ֕אמֶר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστη Δαυεὶδ ἐν μέσῳ τῆς ἐκκλησίας καὶ εἶπεν
traditions.VUL: Cumque surrexísset rex , et stetísset , ait :
traditions.KJV: Then David the king stood up upon his feet , and said ,

2.english_reference: Hear me , my brethren , and my people :

traditions.WLC: שְׁמָע֖וּ נִי אַחַ֣ י וְ עַמִּ֑ י
traditions.LXX: Ἀκούσατέ μου , ἀδελφοὶ καὶ λαός μου .
traditions.VUL: Audíte me fratres mei , et pópulus meus :
traditions.KJV: Hear me , my brethren , and my people : [ As for me ] ,

2.english_reference: [ As for me ] , I [ had ] in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD , and for the footstool of our God ,

traditions.WLC: אֲנִ֣י עִם לְבָבִ֡ י לִ בְנוֹת֩ בֵּ֨ית מְנוּחָ֜ה לַ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֗ה וְ לַ הֲדֹם֙ רַגְלֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔י נוּ
traditions.LXX: ἐμοὶ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ καρδίαν οἰκοδομῆσαι οἶκον ἀναπαύσεως τῆς κιβωτοῦ διαθήκης Κυρίου καὶ στάσιν ποδῶν κυρίου ἡμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: cogitávi ut ædificárem domum , in qua requiésceret arca fœ́deris Dómini , et scabéllum pedum Dei nostri :
traditions.KJV: I [ had ] in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD , and for the footstool of our God ,

2.english_reference: and had made ready for the building :

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲכִינ֖וֹתִי לִ בְנֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡτοίμασα τὰ εἰς τὴν κατασκήνωσιν ἐπιτήδεια ·
traditions.VUL: et ad ædificándum , ómnia præparávi .
traditions.KJV: and had made ready for the building :

3.english_reference: But God said unto me , Thou shalt not build an house for my name ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ אֱלֹהִים֙ אָ֣מַר לִ֔ י לֹא תִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֖יִת לִ שְׁמִ֑ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὁ θεὸς εἶπεν Οὐκ οἰκοδομήσεις ἐμοὶ οἶκον τοῦ ἐπονομάσαι τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐπ᾽ αὐτῷ ,
traditions.VUL: Deus autem dixit mihi : Non ædificábis domum nómini meo ,
traditions.KJV: But God said unto me , Thou shalt not build an house for my name ,

3.english_reference: because thou [ hast been ] a man of war , and hast shed blood .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י אִ֧ישׁ מִלְחָמ֛וֹת אַ֖תָּה וְ דָמִ֥ים שָׁפָֽכְתָּ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἄνθρωπος πολεμιστὴς εἶ σὺ καὶ αἷμα ἐξέχεας .
traditions.VUL: eo quod sis vir bellátor , et sánguinem fúderis .
traditions.KJV: because thou [ hast been ] a man of war , and hast shed blood .

4.english_reference: Howbeit the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever :

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּבְחַ֡ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל בִּ֜ י מִ כֹּ֣ל בֵּית אָבִ֗ י לִ הְי֨וֹת לְ מֶ֤לֶךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְ עוֹלָ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξελέξατο Κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ἰσραὴλ ἐν ἐμοὶ ἀπὸ παντὸς οἴκου πατρός μου εἶναι βασιλέα ἐπὶ Ἰσραὴλ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ·
traditions.VUL: Sed elégit Dóminus Deus Israel me de univérsa domo patris mei , ut essem rex super Israel in sempitérnum :
traditions.KJV: Howbeit the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever :

4.english_reference: for he hath chosen Judah [ to be ] the ruler ;

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י בִֽ יהוּדָה֙ בָּחַ֣ר לְ נָגִ֔יד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν Ἰούδᾳ ᾑρέτικεν τὸ βασίλειον ,
traditions.VUL: de Iuda enim elégit príncipes :
traditions.KJV: for he hath chosen Judah [ to be ] the ruler ;

4.english_reference: and of the house of Judah , the house of my father ;

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ בֵ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξ οἴκου Ἰούδα τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός μου ·
traditions.VUL: porro de domo Iuda , domum patris mei ,
traditions.KJV: and of the house of Judah , the house of my father ;

4.english_reference: and among the sons of my father he liked me to make [ me ] king over all Israel :

traditions.WLC: וּ בִ בְנֵ֣י אָבִ֔ י בִּ֣ י רָצָ֔ה לְ הַמְלִ֖יךְ עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: ἐν ἐμοὶ ἠθέλησεν , τοῦ γενέσθαι με βασιλέα ἐπὶ τῷ παντὶ Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: et de fíliis patris mei plácuit ei ut me elígeret regem super cunctum Israel .
traditions.KJV: and among the sons of my father he liked me to make [ me ] king over all Israel :

5.english_reference: And of all my sons , ( for the LORD hath given me many sons , )

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ כָּ֨ל בָּנַ֔ י כִּ֚י רַבִּ֣ים בָּנִ֔ים נָ֥תַן לִ֖ י יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν υἱῶν μου , ὅτι πολλοὺς υἱοὺς ἔδωκέν μοι Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: Sed et de fíliis meis ( fílios enim mihi multos dedit Dóminus )
traditions.KJV: And of all my sons , ( for the LORD hath given me many sons , )

5.english_reference: he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּבְחַר֙ בִּ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִ֔ י לָ שֶׁ֗בֶת עַל כִּסֵּ֛א מַלְכ֥וּת יְהוָ֖ה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: ἐξελέξατο ἐν Σαλωμὼν τῷ υἱῷ μου καθίσαι αὐτὸν ἐπὶ θρόνου βασιλείας Κυρίου ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: elégit Salomónem fílium meum , ut sedéret in throno regni Dómini super Israel ,
traditions.KJV: he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel .

6.english_reference: And he said unto me , Solomon thy son , he shall build my house and my courts :

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר לִ֔ י שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בִנְ ךָ֔ הֽוּא יִבְנֶ֥ה בֵיתִ֖ י וַ חֲצֵרוֹתָ֑ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπέν μοι ὁ θεός Σαλωμὼν ὁ υἱός σου κληρονομήσει τὸν οἶκόν μου καὶ τὴν αὐλήν μου ,
traditions.VUL: dixítque mihi : Sálomon fílius tuus ædificábit domum meam , et átria mea :
traditions.KJV: And he said unto me , Solomon thy son , he shall build my house and my courts :

6.english_reference: for I have chosen him [ to be ] my son , and I will be his father .

traditions.WLC: כִּי בָחַ֨רְתִּי ב֥ וֹ לִ י֙ לְ בֵ֔ן וַ אֲנִ֖י אֶֽהְיֶה לּ֥ וֹ לְ אָֽב
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ᾑρέτικα ἐν αὐτῷ εἶναί μου υἱόν , κἀγὼ ἔσομαι αὐτῷ εἰς πατέρα .
traditions.VUL: ipsum enim elégi mihi in fílium , et ego ero ei in patrem .
traditions.KJV: for I have chosen him [ to be ] my son , and I will be his father .

7.english_reference: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever ,

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲכִינוֹתִ֥י אֶת מַלְכוּת֖ וֹ עַד לְ עוֹלָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατορθώσω τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ ἕως αἰῶνος ,
traditions.VUL: Et firmábo regnum eius usque in ætérnum ,
traditions.KJV: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever ,

7.english_reference: if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments , as at this day .

traditions.WLC: אִם יֶחֱזַ֗ק לַ עֲשׂ֛וֹת מִצְוֺתַ֥ י וּ מִשְׁפָּטַ֖ י כַּ יּ֥וֹם הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: ἐὰν ἰσχύσῃ τοῦ φυλάξασθαι τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ τὰ κρίματά μου ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη .
traditions.VUL: si perseveráverit fácere præcépta mea , et iudícia , sicut et hódie .
traditions.KJV: if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments , as at this day .

8.english_reference: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the LORD , and in the audience of our God ,

traditions.WLC: וְ֠ עַתָּה לְ עֵינֵ֨י כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל קְהַל יְהוָה֙ וּ בְ אָזְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔י נוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν κατὰ πρόσωπον πάσης ἐκκλησίας Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: Nunc ergo coram univérso cœtu Israel , audiénte Deo nostro ,
traditions.KJV: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the LORD , and in the audience of our God ,

8.english_reference: keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God :

traditions.WLC: שִׁמְר֣וּ וְ דִרְשׁ֔וּ כָּל מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ζητήσατε τὰς ἐντολὰς Κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: custodíte , et perquírite cuncta mandáta Dómini Dei nostri :
traditions.KJV: keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God :

8.english_reference: that ye may possess this good land , and leave [ it ] for an inheritance for your children after you for ever .

traditions.WLC: לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽירְשׁוּ֙ אֶת הָ אָ֣רֶץ הַ טּוֹבָ֔ה וְ הִנְחַלְתֶּ֛ם לִ בְנֵי כֶ֥ם אַחֲרֵי כֶ֖ם עַד עוֹלָֽם
traditions.LXX: ἵνα κληρονομήσητε τὴν γῆν τὴν ἀγαθὴν τοῖς υἱοῖς ἡμῶν ἕως αἰῶνος .
traditions.VUL: ut possideátis terram bonam , et relinquátis eam fíliis vestris post vos usque in sempitérnum .
traditions.KJV: that ye may possess this good land , and leave [ it ] for an inheritance for your children after you for ever .

9.english_reference: And thou , Solomon my son , know thou the God of thy father , and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind :

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתָּ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹֽה בְנִ֡ י דַּע֩ אֶת אֱלֹהֵ֨י אָבִ֜י ךָ וְ עָבְדֵ֗ הוּ בְּ לֵ֤ב שָׁלֵם֙ וּ בְ נֶ֣פֶשׁ חֲפֵצָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν , Σαλωμών , γνῶθι τὸν θεὸν τῶν πατέρων σου καὶ δούλευε ἐν καρδίᾳ τελείᾳ καὶ ψυχῇ θελούσῃ ,
traditions.VUL: Tu autem Sálomon fili mi , scito Deum patris tui , et servíto ei corde perfécto , ánimo voluntário :
traditions.KJV: And thou , Solomon my son , know thou the God of thy father , and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind :

9.english_reference: for the LORD searcheth all hearts , and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts :

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י כָל לְבָבוֹת֙ דּוֹרֵ֣שׁ יְהוָ֔ה וְ כָל יֵ֥צֶר מַחֲשָׁב֖וֹת מֵבִ֑ין
traditions.LXX: ὅτι πάσας καρδίας ἐτάζει Κύριος καὶ πᾶν ἐνθύμημα γιγνώσκει ·
traditions.VUL: ómnia enim corda scrutátur Dóminus , et univérsas méntium cogitatiónes intélligit .
traditions.KJV: for the LORD searcheth all hearts , and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts :

9.english_reference: if thou seek him , he will be found of thee ;

traditions.WLC: אִֽם תִּדְרְשֶׁ֨ נּוּ֙ יִמָּ֣צֵא לָ֔ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἐὰν ζητήσῃς αὐτόν , εὑρεθήσεταί σοι ·
traditions.VUL: Si quæsíeris eum , invénies :
traditions.KJV: if thou seek him , he will be found of thee ;

9.english_reference: but if thou forsake him , he will cast thee off for ever .

traditions.WLC: וְ אִם תַּֽעַזְבֶ֖ נּוּ יַזְנִיחֲ ךָ֥ לָ עַֽד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐὰν καταλείψῃς αὐτόν , καταλείψει σε εἰς τέλος .
traditions.VUL: si autem derelíqueris eum , proíciet te in ætérnum .
traditions.KJV: but if thou forsake him , he will cast thee off for ever .

10.english_reference: Take heed now ; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary :

traditions.WLC: רְאֵ֣ה עַתָּ֗ה כִּֽי יְהוָ֛ה בָּ֧חַר בְּ ךָ֛ לִ בְנֽוֹת בַּ֥יִת לַ מִּקְדָּ֖שׁ
traditions.LXX: ἴδε , τοίνυν · Κύριος ᾑρέτικέν σε οἰκοδομῆσαι αὐτῷ οἶκον εἰς ἁγίασμα ·
traditions.VUL: Nunc ergo quia elégit te Dóminus ut ædificáres domum sanctuárii ,
traditions.KJV: Take heed now ; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary :

traditions.WLC: חֲזַ֥ק וַ עֲשֵֽׂה
traditions.LXX: ἴσχυε καὶ ποίει .
traditions.VUL: confortáre , et pérfice .
traditions.KJV: be strong , and do [ it ] .

11.english_reference: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתֵּ֣ן דָּוִ֣יד לִ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֡ וֹ אֶת תַּבְנִ֣ית הָ אוּלָם֩
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἔδωκεν Δαυεὶδ Σαλωμὼν τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ τὸ παράδειγμα τοῦ ναοῦ
traditions.VUL: Dedit autem David Salomóni fílio suo descriptiónem pórticus ,
traditions.KJV: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch ,

traditions.WLC: וְֽ אֶת בָּ֨תָּ֜י
traditions.LXX: καὶ τῶν οἴκων αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: et templi ,
traditions.KJV: and of the houses thereof ,

traditions.WLC: ו וְ גַנְזַכָּ֧י
traditions.LXX: καὶ τῶν ζακχὼ αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: et cellariórum ,
traditions.KJV: and of the treasuries thereof ,

11.english_reference: and of the upper chambers thereof

traditions.WLC: ו וַ עֲלִיֹּתָ֛י
traditions.LXX: καὶ τῶν ὑπερῴων
traditions.VUL: et cœnáculi ,
traditions.KJV: and of the upper chambers thereof ,

11.english_reference: and of the inner parlours thereof

traditions.WLC: ו וַ חֲדָרָ֥י ו הַ פְּנִימִ֖ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ τῶν ἀποθηκῶν τῶν ἐσωτέρων
traditions.VUL: et cubiculórum in ádytis ,
traditions.KJV: and of the inner parlours thereof ,

11.english_reference: and of the place of the mercy seat

traditions.WLC: וּ בֵ֥ית הַ כַּפֹּֽרֶת
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ ἐξιλασμοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: et domus propitiatiónis ,
traditions.KJV: and of the place of the mercy seat ,

12.english_reference: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit

traditions.WLC: וְ תַבְנִ֗ית כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה בָ ר֨וּחַ֙ עִמּ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ παράδειγμα ὃ εἶχεν ἐν πνεύματι αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: necnon et ómnium quæ cogitáverat
traditions.KJV: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit ,

12.english_reference: of the courts of the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: לְ חַצְר֧וֹת בֵּית יְהוָ֛ה
traditions.LXX: τῶν αὐλῶν οἴκου Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: atriórum ,
traditions.KJV: of the courts of the house of the LORD ,

12.english_reference: and of all the chambers round about
